title: Omar Abdullah to Investors: Focus on Setting Enterprises for Growth
summary: Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah emphasized the importance of setting enterprises for economic growth during a meeting with investors at IIMBue 2026 in Bengaluru. He claimed that the state's real growth lies in this area, citing the need for entrepreneurship and innovation. The government said it is committed to creating an enabling environment for startups. The opposition alleged that the government's focus on enterprise-led growth ignores the concerns of local businesses. Police claimed that no incidents were reported during the meeting.
summary_points: Omar Abdullah emphasized the importance of setting enterprises for economic growth in J&K.

sources.headline: J&K’s real growth lies in setting enterprises; come and unlock growth, Omar Abdullah tells investors
J&K CM Omar Abdullah bats for enterprise-led growth at IIMBue 2026 in Bengaluru
